Quang Phu Cau Incense Village – Check in point in Hanoi is being chosen by many tourists, especially during short vacations or holidays, visitors to the incense village not only visit the scenery or take virtual photos but also learn about the traditional craft village.

Quang Phu Cau Incense Village is one of the famous incense villages, located in Quang Phu Cau commune, Ung Hoa district, Hanoi. This is a traditional craft village that not only brings income to the local people but is also a tourist attraction that many tourists visit, especially young people who like to check in for beautiful photos.

If you are planning to travel to Hanoi, and are wondering where to visit, and where to check in for beautiful photos next to the traditional craft village, then according to Vietlook travel experience, you should visit Quang Phu Cau Incense Village to visit and record beautiful photos to show off to your friends.

Quang Phu Cau Incense Village is a very famous check-in point in the suburbs of Hanoi, although only about 35km from the center of Hanoi, Quang Phu Cau Incense Village has existed for a long time and is still maintained to this day.

From Hanoi capital, you can easily go by motorbike or bus to Quang Phu Cau village. If you like to sit on the bus to see the scenery of the suburbs, choose bus route 91 from Yen Nghia bus station, while traveling, you can admire the peaceful countryside scenery.

Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village is a traditional craft village associated with many generations of Vietnamese people. Currently, the craft village is still preserved and promoted by the skillful hands of the craftsmen of the craft village. Until now, the craft village is still developing strongly and is an attractive destination for tourists from all over the world to visit and enjoy.

Although it has existed for a long time, Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village still exists over the years, has become a unique beauty that clearly depicts the culture of the Northern Delta countryside.

If you are a lover of peaceful space, away from the dust of the city, want to experience rural life and learn about traditional Vietnamese craft villages, then follow Vietlook Travel to explore the beauty of Quang Phu Cau Incense Village today, to explore the beauty of the Vietnamese countryside, with the gentle and hospitable people, beside those gentle smiles, are the skillful hands working day and night to make products to supply to all regions.
